explanation: It fires only at D1 in the very last trials of the episode (about trial 93 onward) when the previous trial chose a2 and was rewarded: about 8 at trials 93-94, 9-10 from trial 96 on, and 5-6 if the trial before that one had chosen a1. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, after an unrewarded trial, after a rewarded a1 choice, and at all steps before about trial 93.
